title: A Balanced Parametrization of Correlation Matrices
abstract: arXiv:2610.14511v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce the balanced correlation parametrization (BCP), which maps positive-definite correlation matrices one-to-one onto the set of symmetric hollow (zero-diagonal) matrices with unrestricted off-diagonal entries. A key feature of the parametrization is that both the transformation and its inverse are available in closed form. It can be viewed as a generalization of the transformation underlying the classical correlation $t$-statistic to higher dimensions. It has a direct interpretation as a scaled sum of marginal and partial correlations, is inverse-consistent and equivariant under variable permutations and sign changes, and preserves block structure. A novel property of BCP is that it preserves correlation sparsity as the dimension tends to infinity under suitable factor conditions, providing a basis for sparse high-dimensional correlation modeling. An empirical illustration using standardized idiosyncratic daily stock return

translated_title: 相关矩阵的平衡参数化方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了平衡相关参数化方法（BCP），该方法将正定相关矩阵与具有无约束非对角元素的对称空心（零对角）矩阵集合进行一一映射。该参数化的一个关键特征是其变换及其逆变换都具有闭式表达式。它可以被视为经典相关t统计量背后变换在高维情形下的推广。该方法可以直接解释为边际相关与偏相关的缩放加和，具有逆一致性，在变量置换和符号变化下保持等变性，并且能够保留块结构。BCP的一个新颖性质是，在适当的因子条件下，随着维数趋于无穷大，它能够保持相关性的稀疏性，从而为稀疏高维相关建模提供了基础。文中还基于标准化的特异日股票收益率进行了实证说明。
tldr: 本文提出了平衡相关参数化（BCP）方法，通过具有闭式解的一一映射将正定相关矩阵与无约束的对称零对角矩阵相互转换，该方法兼具等变性、块结构保持及高维稀疏性保持等优良性质，为稀疏高维相关建模奠定了新基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the balanced correlation parametrization (BCP), a closed-form one-to-one mapping between positive-definite correlation matrices and unconstrained symmetric hollow matrices, which offers equivariance, block-structure preservation, and asymptotic sparsity retention, providing a new foundation for sparse high-dimensional correlation modeling.
